name: Special Joint City Council & Housing Authority - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special Joint City Council & Housing Authority - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 6, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
City Council: Council Members Hinze, Kranz, Mosca, Deputy Mayor Hubbard and Mayor Blakespear
Housing Authority: Commissioners Chavez, Hinze, Kranz, Mohler, Mosca, Vice Chair Hubbard and Chair Blakespear
Encinitas Housing Authority members receive an independent stipend of $50 for convening the Housing Authority meetings pursuant to Housing Authority Resolution No. 94-04.
AGENDA ITEMS
H1.
Contract Amendment #2 with Hyder & Company to extend the contract term and allow for additional costs for Property Management Services and Maintenance of sixteen Encinitas Housing Authority Owned Condominium Units at Pacific Pines. Contact Person: Housing Analyst Piano-Jones
Authorize the Executive Director, or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to sign Contract Amendment No. 2 in substantial form with Hyder & Company to: 1) Extend the term of the existing Property Management and Maintenance Contract for a three-month period, from April 1, 2019 to June 30, 2019, and increase the contract amount $10,000; with all other contract provisions to remain in place; and 2) Effective July 1, 2019, further extend the term of the existing Property Management and Maintenance Contract for a three-year period, from July 1, 2019 to June 30, 2022; include clarifying language related to eligible personnel and mileage expenses; and increase the contract amount by $137,649 for a total contract amount, from April 1, 2016 to June 30, 2022, not to exceed $267,282.
2019-02-06 Item H1 Contract Amendment #2 Hyder and Company
2019-02-06 Item H1 Amended Attachment 1 (Added 02-04-2019)
H2.
General Discussion of Housing Issues including review and direction in response to the State Housing and Community Development (HCD) 45-day Review Comment Letter regarding the draft Housing Plan Update 2019. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
Staff Recommends that the Council: 1) Provide direction as appropriate related to the HCD 45-day Review Letter regarding the draft Housing Plan Update; and 2) Review and discuss other housing issues and provide direction as appropriate.
2019-02-06 Item H2 General Discussion of Housing Issues and HCD 45 Day Review Comment Letter
2019-02-06 Item H2 HCD Comment Letter (Added 02-04-2019)
ADJOURNMENT
H2.
General Discussion of Housing Issues including review and direction in response to the State Housing and Community Development (HCD) 45-day Review Comment Letter regarding the draft Housing Plan Update 2019. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
Staff Recommends that the Council: 1) Provide direction as appropriate related to the HCD 45-day Review Letter regarding the draft Housing Plan Update; and 2) Review and discuss other housing issues and provide direction as appropriate.
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
